  fun inner()
    throw
      Call UnwrapException
  fun outer(): Int
    try
      Call inner
      return
        IntLiteral 0
    finally
      Call println
        StringLiteral "outer-finally"
  fun main()
    try
      Call outer
    catch e: UnwrapException
      Call println
        StringLiteral "caught in main"
